import Mathlib.RingTheory.DiscreteValuationRing.Basic
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Kaehler.Basic

/-!
# Parameter independence for simple-pole residues

If two local parameters clear the same simple pole, the coefficients of the
resulting regular differentials have the same residue in their respective
parameter differential frames. This is the local algebra identity used to
construct the residue on differentials with at most a simple pole.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

namespace Hartshorne

open IsLocalRing

/-- Clearing a simple pole with either of two local parameters gives the same
residue coefficient, when each coefficient is measured in the differential
of its corresponding parameter. -/
theorem residue_differentialCoordinate_eq_of_smul_eq
    {k R : Type*} [CommRing k] [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] [Algebra k R]
    (t s : R) (ht : Irreducible t) (hs : Irreducible s)
    (et es : R ≃ₗ[R] Ω[R⁄k])
    (het : et 1 = KaehlerDifferential.D k R t)
    (hes : es 1 = KaehlerDifferential.D k R s)
    (α β : Ω[R⁄k]) (h : s • α = t • β) :
    residue R (et.symm α) = residue R (es.symm β) := by
  obtain ⟨u, hu⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.associated_of_irreducible R ht hs
  have hcoord : (u : R) * et.symm α = et.symm β := by
    have h' := congrArg et.symm h
    simp only [map_smul, smul_eq_mul] at h'
    rw [← hu, mul_assoc] at h'
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ ht.ne_zero h'
  have hdt : et.symm (KaehlerDifferential.D k R t) = 1 := by
    rw [← het, et.symm_apply_apply]
  have hds : et.symm (KaehlerDifferential.D k R s) =
      (u : R) + t * et.symm (KaehlerDifferential.D k R (u : R)) := by
    rw [← hu, Derivation.leibniz, map_add, map_smul, map_smul, hdt]
    simp only [smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
    exact add_comm _ _
  have hβ : et.symm β = es.symm β *
      ((u : R) + t * et.symm (KaehlerDifferential.D k R (u : R))) := by
    calc
      et.symm β = et.symm (es (es.symm β)) := by rw [es.apply_symm_apply]
      _ = et.symm (es.symm β • es 1) := by rw [← map_smul, smul_eq_mul, mul_one]
      _ = _ := by rw [map_smul, hes, hds, smul_eq_mul]
  have htres : residue R t = 0 := by
    rw [residue_eq_zero_iff, ht.maximalIdeal_eq]
    exact Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton t)
  have hu' : residue R (u : R) ≠ 0 := (u.isUnit.map (residue R)).ne_zero
  apply mul_left_cancel₀ hu'
  have hres := congrArg (residue R) (hcoord.trans hβ)
  simpa only [map_mul, map_add, htres, zero_mul, add_zero, mul_comm] using hres

end Hartshorne
